# A bill overpaid from the expense split of an existing transaction.
#
# 150.00 was paid on the card against a bill that owes 100.00, so the split
# has to be divided: 100.00 becomes the settlement and the 50.00 left over is
# the vendor's credit, which `prepayment:` states.
#
# This is the division the new arm reaches. On the ordinary arm the split
# being divided sat on an asset; here it is the expense copy of the bill's own
# line, so the expense account has to end at the bill's own 100.00 with the
# whole 150.00 gone from it.
#
# What this fixture produces: the payable holding a 50.00 credit, the cost at
# 100.00, and the card at −150.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-OVER-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-26
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-26
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-26
    due: 2026-03-26
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-OVER-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-26
    amount: 150
    account: "Liabilities:Credit Card USD"
    txn_guid: "778899aabbccddeeff00112233445566"
    prepayment: 50
